fusions.name: Skirting Strikes
fusions.desc: Looses 3 quick strikes spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Startling Flit
fusions.desc: Darts into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Low Skim
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds and your dodge chance by 15% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Lightfooted Glide
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 14%.
